create_dpt_image_processor: create a DPTImageProcessorPil instance for preprocessing images for DPT depth estimation models
preprocess_images_dpt: preprocess images and optional segmentation maps for DPT model input with resize, rescale, and normalize
resize_image_dpt: resize an image to a target size while preserving aspect ratio and constraining to a multiple of a divisor
post_process_semantic_segmentation: post-process DPT model logits into semantic segmentation maps resized to target image sizes
post_process_depth_estimation: post-process DPT model depth predictions and interpolate them to original target image sizes
